title.zh: OpenAI最快周五发布新模型，Astra、Sol及网络安全模型或齐亮相
title.en: OpenAI最快周五发布新模型，Astra、Sol及网络安全模型或齐亮相

current_state.zh: OpenAI may release as soon as Friday a batch of new models — the flagship Astra (GPT-6.1), a next-generation Sol, and a cybersecurity-specific model — after Astra's October launch was cancelled due to failed internal safety tests.
